title: Medical Receptionist / Admin
description: We are offering a part-time receptionist/administrator, to join our friendly team. To be successful in this role, you will be a friendly, approachable and reliable team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both face-to-face and over the telephone. You will be confident working in a busy environment, able to remain calm under pressure, and capable of managing multiple tasks efficiently while maintaining a high standard of patient service. The successful candidate must be available to start in December 2026. Flexibility is essential, as the role will involve working a variety of shifts, including early starts from 8:00 am and/or late finishes at 8:00 pm. You will also be expected to provide holiday cover when required. Previous experience using EMIS Web is essential. The successful candidate must be confident using the system to support the day-to-day running of the practice and be comfortable using computer systems to manage administrative tasks efficiently. Reception Duties and Responsibilities Welcoming patients and visitors, answering telephone calls, emails and online consultations professionally. Booking appointments via EMIS Web and directing patients to the appropriate clinician or service. Processing medical report requests and cash payments, ensuring requests are completed within agreed timeframes. Printing forms for clinics, including blood tests and X-rays. Providing specimen pots and forms, ensuring dates and times are correctly recorded. Registering new patients and recording clinical information, including blood pressure and weight readings. Maintaining a tidy reception area and replenishing supplies. Supporting distressed or vulnerable patients with empathy and handling challenging situations sensitively. Recalling patients for essential reviews, including diabetes, to support QOF targets. Scanning, coding and filing documents into patient records using Docman. Monitoring and ordering clinical and administrative supplies. Liaising professionally and confidentially with other healthcare departments. Completing mandatory training and contributing to enhanced services, CQC requirements, audits and quality improvement activities. Opening and securing the premises when required. Providing flexible cover for colleagues, including short-notice sickness absence. Additional hours will be reimbursed where agreed in advance, in accordance with practice policy. We are offering a part-time receptionist/administrator, to join our small friendly team. In order to be successful, you must be a good team player with excellent communication skills both face to face and over the telephone, as well as being able to work under pressure and having the ability to multitask. We require someone who is flexible as the position will involve morning shifts (8:00am) and/or late evenings (8:00pm), as well as someone who is willing to cover holidays. You will need to be able to start in December 2026. The practice uses EMIS web as the clinical system, so it is preferable that you have had experience in using this tool or you are computer literate and can adapt to different software systems efficiently. Main duties: - Reception Welcoming patients and visitors, answering calls, emails and online consultations, ensuring needs are met. Booking appointments appropriately via EMIS, directing them to the correct clinician. Assisting patients with medical reports, dealing with cash payments and completing request within the given time frame. Printing and handing out forms for patients to take to different clinics e.g. Blood test and x-ray forms. Supporting patients with specimen pots and forms, making sure the date and time on both forms and sample. Registering new patients and recording clinical information, such as blood pressure readings and weight for monitoring purposes. Keeping reception area tidy, replacing any empty items. Comforting distressed patients, handling with difficult needs. - Admin Recalling patients for vital appointments, such as diabetes reviews, meeting the requirements for QOF. Request and return paper notes as necessary Scanning and Filing in documents via Docman10 into patients records Completing tasks set by clinicians on workflow. Ordering items (clinical and admin) when low, ensuring there is a sufficient stock. Dealing with requests for home visits and recording them on their record. Chasing up appointments and results from hospitals either via phone or email Liaising with other medical departments, such as radiologists or psychologists with professionalism and discretion Ordering ambulances for patients and clinicians, both routinely and in an emergency Completing all mandatory training for quality purposes - General Active involvement in enhanced service, CQC and quality related work. Opening the premises and securing at night, when required. Dealing with problems and queries from the doctors, other staff, attached staff and other organisations. Following and adhering to Practice admin protocols. Be flexible to cover colleagues in their absence including short notice cover for sickness. This may result in longer working hours or different days to normal working days (reimbursement for agreed additional hours worked will be made). - Quality The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk. Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision. Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance. Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs. Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. - Equality and Diversity The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with Practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. - Health & Safety The post holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health and safety and security as laid out in the staff handbook and health and safety manual. This will include Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way free from hazards. Reporting potential risks identified. This job description is not exhaustive and duties may vary with the requirements of the practice or as directed by the Partners.

title: Digital Receptionist
description: Millway Medical Practice is a large, high-performing NHS GP practice serving ~25,000 patients in Mill Hill, North London. We are looking for a Digital Receptionist / eConsult Coordinator to join our expanding team. This is a key frontline role in a modern, digitally-driven GP practice , focused on managing online patient demand (eConsults) alongside supporting core reception and telephony functions. You will play a crucial role in ensuring patients are navigated safely, efficiently, and compassionately to the right care, at the right time. We can offer full-time or part-time hours for the right candidate. To act as a central point of coordination for online consultations (eConsult) and digital patient access , ensuring: Timely and accurate processing of eConsults Safe navigation of patients to appropriate services Support for reception and phone systems during peak demand High-quality patient experience in a fast-paced environment 1. eConsult & Digital Workflow Management (Primary Function) Monitor and process incoming eConsults throughout the day Triage and allocate requests in line with practice protocols Identify urgent or high-risk submissions and escalate appropriately Book patients into appropriate appointments (GP, ACP, PA pharmacist, etc.) Communicate outcomes to patients via SMS, AccuRx or phone Ensure all eConsults are actioned within agreed timeframes Support optimisation of digital workflows and demand management Answer incoming calls using cloud telephony systems (Surgery Connect) Navigate patients to the most appropriate service (appointments, self-care, pharmacy, etc.) Book, amend and cancel appointments using EMIS Web Support front desk when required, including greeting patients Manage patient queries efficiently and professionally Guide patients through the triage model Promote use of online services (eConsult, NHS App, website) Signpost to appropriate services (community pharmacy, urgent care, etc.) Support vulnerable patients who may struggle with digital access Process registrations and update patient records Handle basic prescription/admin queries Scan and process incoming documents (BetterLetter / Docman where required) Support digital communication campaigns (SMS, website updates) Maintain accurate records and data quality Work collaboratively with reception, admin and clinical teams Provide cover during staff absence or peak demand periods Support onboarding and training of new staff where appropriate

title: GP Receptionist
description: CQC review date: 11.9.2026 GOOD Our work environment includes: Modern office setting Growth opportunities We are looking for a professional and experienced receptionist to work in our busy clinic. Triaging patient efficiently Good working in teams Good communicator We are looking for a friendly, professional and motivated GP Receptionist to join our busy and supportive practice team. title: Medical Receptionist
description: Undertake general reception and administrative duties. To receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the practice Organise appointments on the computerised appointments system, maintaining an awareness of the partners rota and prevailing conditions that could affect the optimum management of appointments. Using your own judgment and communication skills ensure that patients with no prior appointment but who need urgent consultation are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Take accurate messages, assessing their urgency, and passing on the information appropriately to doctors, nurses and other staff attached to the practice Use tact, diplomacy and care when dealing with patients who may be upset, including those who may react aggressively or abusively To undertake a variety of administrative tasks adhering to set practice protocols and to implement and initiate new policies where necessary Cover where necessary in the absence of other receptionists/administrators on sick or annual leave etc. Undertake general administrative duties. To undertake any other duties which may reasonably be delegated by the Partners and the Practice Manager Make appointments and check in patients on the computerised appointments system, maintaining an awareness of the partners rota and prevailing conditions that could affect the optimum management of appointments. Advise new patients of the registration process. Receive payments from patients and record accurately in cash receipt books and provide receipts Be aware of external organisations and their relationship with the practice e.g. Barnet Federation Hub and choose and book system Keep the reception office, records and waiting rooms tidy and undertake any other tasks which contribute to the smooth and efficient organisation of these areas Attend suitable training sessions or courses, approved by the Practice Manager, in order to enhance skills and knowledge including online training through Blue Stream Academy.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: HAMPSTEAD GROUP PRACTICE (NW3 2QU) Medical Receptionist Full-Time or Part-Time Posts Hourly rate: £ 14.20 Various shifts between 8am to 6.30pm, Monday - Friday We are seeking highly organised, motivated individuals with excellent customer service skills to support our Patient Services Team. Candidates must be computer literate, flexible and able to work under pressure. Previous NHS experience and knowledge of EMIS Web clinical system are preferred but not essential. First point of contact for patients registered with the practice. Answering phone calls and email queries from patients and external organisations. Triaging calls to book patients into the appropriate clinics or signpost patients to appropriate services Dealing with prescription requests and liasing with pharmacies as and when required Providing admin support to clinical team HAMPSTEAD GROUP PRACTICE JOB DESCRIPTION Title: Patient Services Team Accountable to: Practice Manager Reports to: Patient Services Manager Liaises with: Patients and Users of the Practice,Professional Members of the Practice Team,Other Administration Staff JOB SUMMARY The postholder will be responsible for ensuring that an efficient and personable service is provided to all users of the Hampstead Group Practice. They should ensure that the patient is dealt with courteously and is kept fully informed at all times whether on the telephone or face to face. They should ensure that due confidentiality is observed at all times when dealing with any issue relating to the Hampstead Group Practice. RECEPTION DUTIES: 1. To undertake to open up the surgery (when appropriate) and prepare the premises to receive patients. 2. To ensure the main practice telephone lines are opened and closed at the appropriate times. 3. To ensure that home visits are entered onto the relevant computerised file and that these are brought to the attention of the duty doctor. 4. To receive and direct patients appropriately, including those attending the travel clinic and private medicals. 5. To book patients into available appointments either by telephone or in person following the current practice protocol and when requested by a member of the medical staff. 6. To undertake to answer the telephone promptly, taking clear and accurate messages where necessary, ensuring that messages are passed to the correct person in an approved manner for patients of the practice and for the travel clinic. 7. To undertake to print and prepare repeat prescriptions ready for signature by a doctor. 8. To undertake to issue repeat prescriptions and other reports, forms, and letters, etc., to patients that are ready for collection. 9. To collect monies from patients for items for which a patient charge applies. 10. To undertake to assist or aid patients with disabilities as and when required. 11. To undertake to act as a chaperone to a patient if required to do so by a doctor or nurse. 12. To undertake to book transport for patients when appropriate. 13. To answer the results line, deal appropriately with result requests, both in person, and by telephone. 14. To undertake to process New Registrations. 15. To report any potentially aggressive incidents, difficulties with the client group or accidents in the first instant to the Patient Services Manager, or Practice Manager for appropriate action. 16. To undertake to be aware of any potential security breaches of the building whilst on duty. 17. To ensure that the premises are securely locked at the end of the working day; ensuring that doors to rooms not in use are closed; that the Library and Seminar room doors are locked and all windows are securely closed and locked where appropriate. 18. To ensure to the appropriate message is displayed on front door/gate when the premises are closed. 19. To ensure that the premises are kept tidy and that magazines and leaflets within the waiting area are tidied prior to the commencement and at the end of each clinical session. 20. To assist in maintaining a clean and safe environment for staff, patients and users of the practice. 21. To use the computer system appropriately and be able to re-start/re-boot an individual computer workstation should it be necessary. OTHER DUTIES The following lists of duties are to be carried out by Patient Services Team. No Patient Services Team members should carry out any of the following duties unless they have been specifically trained. These duties are not in any order and may be allocated to one or more persons. Specific Duties: 1. To undertake Child Immunisation and Vaccination target work as and when required. 2. To undertake Cervical Screening target work as and when required. 3. To undertake the scanning of patient's results and any other patient correspondence into the patients' computerised records. 4. To undertake to process and return patient records to and from Primary Care Support England (NHS England). 5. To ensure that all temporary resident claims and immediate necessary claims have been made. 6. To undertake to ensure that newly registered patients' records are matched/married to their existing health record when it arrives from Primary Care Support England (NHS England) 7. To undertake to monitor and assist with two week wait referrals promptly via the e-Referral system 8. To open external post and post from Royal Free Hospital on a daily basis, date stamp and distribute as per the practice protocol 9. To provide support to the management team as and when required The allocation of duties will be by the Practice Manager or Patient Services Manager and staff will be expected to take on additional duties or relinquish existing duties to ensure the efficient running of the practice. Requests for such changes, when they occur should not reasonably be refused. This job description is not meant to be exhaustive and may change with the agreement of the Practice Manager and the post holder. The agreement to any change by the post holder should not be reasonably withheld.

title: Medical Receptionist

The role includes both front desk and back office duties. Hours by mutual agreement to be part of a team of six staff covering 0745 to 1830, Monday to Friday. Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Carry out administrative tasks relating to patient records, including filing, document management and ensuring patients can access reports, prescriptions and that they are easily accessible. Give administrative support to the clinicians, practice manager and reception manager where appropriate and as requested. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. Follow practice protocols to ensure consistent and high quality care is provided to our patients. To have a thorough knowledge of all practice procedures To work in accordance of written protocols Scan incoming post and other documents for electronic filing of clinical correspondence Action third party requests for medical records in accordance with practice protocol Prepare and open up practice at start of day when on early duty Greet & receive patients, consulting with members of practice team Check patients in on arrival using the practice computer system (EMIS) or direct them to self-check in. Oversee the reception area in such a way that ensures all patients are seen in turn Deal with prescriptions Be able to cover all reception tasks as necessary Close and secure practice at end of day when on late duty Process appointment requests for today/future appointments from patients by telephone and in person using the practice computer system (EMIS) Registrations of new regular patients and temporary patients computer data entry and medical records Maintain working knowledge of telephone system Answer telephone calls to the practice dealing with enquiries, fielding calls where appropriate or taking messages using the practice electronic message book Sort and date stamp all incoming patient-related mail Scan patient-related documents onto medical records using read codes as agreed by the clinical team Forward relevant documents to the doctor or nurse Ensure incoming letters are scanned onto the patient record Scan all internal paper documents on to the relevant patients record and then store the documents in line with practice procedure

title: Care Navigator/Receptionist & Administrator
description: As the first point of contact for patients, you will play a key role in delivering excellent customer service and supporting the smooth running of the practice. Duties include welcoming patients, handling telephone and face-to-face enquiries, responding to emails, processing prescription requests, filing and coding clinical correspondence and referrals, supporting safeguarding processes, undertaking site checks, monitoring stock levels, and helping maintain a safe environment. Working as part of a team of four, you will contribute to a shared workload and help ensure patients receive the right support at the right time. The role is offered on a split rota of 07:45-13:45 (Week 1) and 13:00-19:00 (Week 2) . Previous experience in a GP practice or similar patient-facing role is essential. Applicants must have 6-12 months' experience and be proficient in EMIS Web . The successful candidate must deliver excellent patient care and customer service while maintaining professionalism and accuracy. If you are a reliable team player with excellent communication skills, attention to detail and a commitment to patient care, we would love to hear from you. As a Patient Care Navigator / Receptionist / Administrator, you will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors, providing a professional, friendly and efficient service. You will welcome patients, respond to enquiries in person and by telephone, and support patients in accessing the most appropriate services. The role includes processing prescription requests, responding to emails, filing and coding clinical correspondence, maintaining accurate patient records, processing referrals via NHS e-Referral Service, actioning eConsults as directed by the clinical team, managing appointments, registering new patients, and handling general enquiries. You will be expected to cover colleagues' absences where required, attend practice meetings, maintain a tidy reception area, support patient recall programmes, and undertake additional administrative tasks as directed by the Practice Manager. You will support safeguarding processes, undertake site checks, monitor stock levels, report issues appropriately, and help ensure the premises are safe and secure. Working as part of a team of four, you will share workloads, support colleagues during busy periods, and contribute to a positive, patient-focused environment. Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, flexibility and a commitment to high-quality patient care are essential. Job description Key Responsibilities Patient Care & Reception Meet and greet patients and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner. Assist patients with enquiries, signposting them to the most appropriate service where necessary. Respond to patient queries both in person and over the telephone. Support patients with appointments, registrations and general practice services. Always maintain patient confidentiality. Administrative Duties Process incoming hospital correspondence, including filing and clinical coding of letters and reports. Process prescription requests accurately and efficiently. Respond promptly to emails received by the practice. Maintain accurate patient records and update information as required. Undertake general administrative tasks to support the smooth running of the practice. Safeguarding & Compliance Identify and escalate any safeguarding concerns or requests appropriately. Follow all practice policies, procedures and information governance requirements. Support the practice in maintaining a safe environment for patients, staff and visitors. Premises & Operational Support Carry out routine site and building checks as required. Ensure the building is secure at opening and closing times. Monitor and maintain appropriate stock levels of clinical and office supplies. Report maintenance issues or concerns promptly. Teamworking Work collaboratively as part of a team of four within the reception and administration function. Support colleagues during busy periods and contribute positively to team objectives. Participate fully in the shared workload and demonstrate flexibility where required. Promote a positive, patient-focused culture throughout the practice.

title: ED Receptionist

title: GP Receptionist
description: Join Dr Sharma & Rai Practice Group as a full-time GP Receptionist, primarily based at Heathway Medical Centre in Dagenham. You will be a welcoming first point of contact for patients and a valued member of our friendly and supportive practice team. We are looking for someone reliable, organised and confident communicating with people face to face. Previous GP reception experience is an advantage, but not essential. We also welcome applicants with strong customer service experience who enjoy helping people, can manage a variety of tasks and are quick to learn new online systems. Good IT skills, excellent communication and a friendly, professional approach are essential. This is a fixed-term position until 8 August 2027, with the possibility of extension. The role is 37.5 hours per week, working varied shifts between 07:45 and 18:30, Monday to Friday, excluding bank holidays. Pay is £12.71 per hour. Our wider practice group offers opportunities to gain experience, develop new skills and apply for permanent positions as vacancies arise. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if sufficient applications are received. Early applications are encouraged. As a GP Receptionist, you will play an important role in supporting patients and helping the practice run smoothly. Your daily responsibilities will include: Welcoming patients and visitors, providing friendly and professional assistance. Responding to patient enquiries face to face, by telephone and through online systems. Helping patients access appropriate services, including assisting with online appointment requests. Using our clinical system (EMIS Web) and other digital platforms to manage patient information and administrative tasks. Processing patient requests, including prescriptions, test-related enquiries and general correspondence. Supporting GPs, nurses and other team members with day-to-day administrative duties. Maintaining accurate records and handling confidential information appropriately. Working closely with colleagues to provide a positive experience for patients. Full training and guidance on our practice systems and procedures will be provided. We value teamwork, initiative and a willingness to learn. Job Description GP Receptionist Organisation: Dr Sharma & Rai Practice Group Primary Location: Heathway Medical Centre, Dagenham Contract: Full-time, fixed-term until 8 August 2027, with the possibility of extension Hours: 37.5 hours per week, with varied shifts between 07:45 and 18:30, Monday to Friday, excluding bank holidays. To provide a friendly, professional and efficient reception and administrative service to patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. The GP Receptionist plays an important role in supporting patients to access healthcare services, maintaining accurate records and assisting the wider practice team with daily operations. The successful candidate will be based primarily at Heathway Medical Centre, with occasional cover at other practices within Dr Sharma & Rai Practice Group where required. 1. Patient Reception and Customer Service Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, helpful and professional manner. Act as a first point of contact for patients attending the practice. Support patients who may require additional assistance accessing healthcare services. Communicate clearly and sensitively with patients from different backgrounds and with varying needs. Handle patient concerns and difficult situations calmly, professionally and respectfully, referring matters to senior colleagues when appropriate. Maintain a welcoming, organised and professional reception environment. 2. Appointment Management and Patient Access Support patients with accessing appointments and services in accordance with practice procedures. Assist patients in using online consultation and appointment request systems. Provide guidance on accessing the NHS App and other available digital services. Process appointment requests, cancellations and changes as directed by practice procedures. Signpost patients to appropriate services using established practice guidance and care navigation procedures. Escalate urgent concerns or clinical queries to the appropriate healthcare professional without providing clinical advice. Help ensure patients receive clear and accurate information about practice services. 3. Clinical Systems and Digital Administration Use EMIS Web and other practice systems to access and update patient information accurately. Process patient requests received through online platforms and electronic communication systems. Scan, upload and attach relevant documents to patient records. Teamwork and Communication Work collaboratively with reception colleagues, GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants and administrative staff. We welcome candidates with experience in customer-facing roles who demonstrate strong communication skills, a positive attitude, good computer skills and a willingness to learn. title: GP Receptionist

As the first point of contact for patients, youll play a vital role in making every patient feel welcome, listened to, and supported. Youll handle calls, manage appointments, process correspondence, and assist the GP and wider team in delivering excellent service. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping others, communicates clearly and kindly, and can stay calm under pressure. Youll need to be organised, confident using computers, and committed to maintaining confidentiality at all times. In return, we offer a friendly working environment, on-the-job training, and opportunities for personal development. Youll be part of a small, close-knit team where your contribution truly makes a difference to the lives of our patients and the success of our practice. If youre reliable, compassionate, and looking for a rewarding role in the heart of London, wed love to hear from you. Welcome and assist patients and visitors in person and over the telephone in a professional and friendly manner. Manage incoming calls, respond to general enquiries, and direct calls as appropriate. Schedule and manage patient appointments using the practice clinical system - EMIS Web. Register new patients and update existing patient information accurately. Handle incoming and outgoing post and emails. Obtain external medical reports, test results, and other documentation as required. Scan and file correspondence and clinical documents. Maintain a tidy, organised, and welcoming reception area. Safeguard patient confidentiality and comply with GDPR and NHS data protection requirements. Provide reassurance and support to patients, maintaining a calm and caring approach. Carry out general administrative duties as required by the GP or Practice Manager. Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the Practice. Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. Using your own judgment and communication skills ensure that patients with no prior appointment but who need urgent consultation are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Explain Practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Enter requests for home visits into the home visits book, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details and where necessary refer to Duty Doctor. Action repeat prescription requests and ensure that they are ready for collection by the patient within 48 hours, in line with Practice protocol. Take action on clinicians requests for further information/patient contact information etc. including computerised practice notes, ensuring completion of all associated paperwork. Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non-General Medical Services) services, accept payment and issue receipts for same. Enter patient information on to the computer as required. Prepare clinical rooms for surgeries, supply prescription forms and record numbers in use and ensure adequate supplies of consumables - including bottles, couch rolls, test request forms etc..
